name: Professional
note: Charcoal surfaces; distinct primary, secondary and tertiary blue controls; clear input and selection states. Preserve normative Professional tokens.

name: Glow
note: Warm accent gradients and luminous controls. The supplied component sheets distinguish default, hover and entered/focused input states.

name: Playful
note: Soft rounded shapes, varied coloured surfaces, generous grouping and a friendly hierarchy. Transfer material and control treatment, not the reference app layout.

name: Frost
note: Frost reference folder: layered translucent-looking surfaces and soft pale gradients. Likely relevant to Frosted Glass, but no rename is authorised. Retain the existing no-Gaussian/Mica restriction unless explicitly revised.

name: Bubble
note: Watery / glossy volume, translucent-looking edges and buoyant rounded controls. Still images do not establish motion timings; retain the specified reduced-motion rules.

name: Industrial
note: Physical controls, embossed/metal-like surfaces, bevelled edges and instrumentation. Possible relationship to Metallic is not confirmed; preserve both names in the mapping ledger.

name: Retro
note: Terminal-like contrast, monospace chrome, crisp panels and restrained accent use. Do not tint authored documents or copy another product identity.

name: Western
note: Wood grain, inset frames, warm parchment and sepia-like chrome. Material reference only: do not reproduce game mechanics, branded assets or decorative clutter.

name: Synthwave
note: Deep blue/purple surfaces, luminous gradients and bold visual hierarchy. Not a current built-in theme in the supplied specification; no automatic theme registration.

name: Snug
note: Soft tactile-looking, plush rounded controls. Not a current built-in theme in the supplied specification; no automatic theme registration.
